subject: Genetics
title: Pharmacogenomics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Pharmacogenomics.

hook.text: The same drug can save one patient and harm another. The difference is in their genes.

buildup.text: CYP450 enzymes metabolize most drugs. Genetic variants make some people fast metabolizers, others dangerously slow.

discovery.text: Codeine is safe for most but lethal for ultra-rapid metabolizers who convert it to toxic morphine levels.

twist.text: The FDA recommends gene testing before 300+ drugs. Yet most doctors still prescribe by standard dosing.

climax.text: Matching drugs to genotypes prevents bad reactions and finds the right dose first. Precision over guesswork.

punchline.text: Right drug, right dose, right patient. Genes decide.

quiz.question: What does pharmacogenomics aim to do?
options: Match drugs and doses to a patient's genetics
